HED.prologue: testaux 1.0.0 is the auxiliary-items library of the hed-tests test schema set, partnered with standard schema 8.5.0. It declares one auxiliary element of each type - unit class auxUnits with units auxunit and bigauxunit, unit modifier auxMod, value class auxClass, and schema attribute auxAttribute - plus the tags Aux-measure and Aux-value that use them, so the auxiliary-section merge rules have fully controlled probes. testclash 13.0.0 and later carry probe copies of these elements, identical except for at most one controlled difference. It has no predecessor.

node.name: Aux-measure
node.description: A tag that takes a value with units of the auxUnits unit class.

node.name: Aux-value
node.description: A tag that takes a value of the auxClass value class.
